programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: After 10 years of marriage and two children, it seems that Greg Focker has finally earned a place in the "circle of trust" of his uptight father-in-law, Jack. However, Greg is moonlighting with a drug company, which raises Jack's suspicions. As two clans descend on the scene of the young twins' birthday party, Greg must find a way through myriad misunderstandings to prove to Jack -- once and for all -- that he is worthy of being the next family patriarch.

programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element.

programme.title: The Carson City Kid
programme.desc: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).
